shared_mechanics.observer: Private optional sparse battlefield observer registry (None in ordinary games), registered/forgotten with battlefield and face/copy providers; current actor/current creature classification at actual committed activation. Ordinary/legacy/announced/borrowed nonmana, basic/granted/activated/borrowed mana routes dispatch once. Copies and speculative funding do not dispatch. Current activating ObjectRef overrides the borrowed ability definition; source-departure facts cover sacrifice costs; hand cycling creature cards are excluded. Cold no-observer fast exits avoid characteristic queries on ordinary nonmana/basic mana activation paths.
shared_mechanics.limit: Reuses existing exact-object TriggerUse with ability origin. Same incarnation retains its consumed limit through control and ability loss/restore; new generation and new turn reset naturally. Queueing consumes limit, regardless of later countering.
shared_mechanics.payment_replay: Observers queue during mana payment but cannot stack until enclosing announcement completes. Selective mana replay suppresses recomputation, retains original frozen packets and restores their exact consumed TriggerUse only for kept events; reversed events retain neither. No public history/wire field.
shared_mechanics.blink: All surviving exact legal exile targets and before-event owners are frozen before departure. Successful Exile destinations/non-token exact generations are collected into ONE delayed return group per instruction/originating activation. Each group queues ONE delayed trigger, whose resolution independently validates every exact reference and stages all surviving entries in ONE entry batch, including suspended choice-bearing entry. Multiple originating activations retain independent groups. No priority or ETB observer collection occurs between group members. Tokens get no return link; owner/controller/counter/tapped data remain per-card. Companion allocations included in state and stack-packet owned-byte accounting.

wire: Root-approved schema158 addition: ReturnLinkView.additional_returning:Option<Box<Vec<ReturnCardView>>> serialized only when Some, containing flat object/zone/controller/counter/tapped records. ReturnCardView has no companion field, statically preventing nested groups. Singleton delayed-return/death/immediate links retain prior JSON shape/values. Group companions are visible in both delayed-return views and pending/stack SpellView.return_link, owned by the exact originating activation and accounted in state/packet bytes. Leaf does not change central version; root integrates alongside Elven Passage/Bolg schema158.

printed_assertion_map.Draw one; only once each turn: Actual hand/counter deltas, multiple qualifying actions, suppression/restore, control change, blink new incarnation, next turn, two observers, copied activation exclusion; countered ability still draws, countered draw still consumes limit, kept/reversed mana replay has exact frozen draw and latch.

printed_assertion_map.Exile then return cards under OWNERS at: Exact owner vs controller, one trigger per activation; countering it leaves all cards exiled. Multiple activations retain independent groups. Every card exact-reference validated independently, including stale exile generation/token/entry replacement/after-end timing. A returning Fíli sees itself AND the earlier-declared other returning Dwarf in one simultaneous entry batch.

Return proof: Adaptive Automaton entry-type choice holds BOTH exiled cards until all choices finish, then one batch commits; raw/index/restore representative contracts plus parent drop and independent children. Both public observations expose complete flat companion records; singleton serialization omits the new field.
